item.title: City of Toronto recognizes World TB Day as it remains one of the top ten causes of death worldwide
item.description: News Release March 24, 2026 Toronto Public Health (TPH), in support of the global Stop TB Partnership (stoptb.org), recognizes World Tuberculosis (TB) Day on March 24.
